texts.conductor_enter_hint: Don't <color=#FF7717>play dices</color> with strangers on the train - you could lose all your money!
texts.passenger_random_0: What a beautiful day for a trip!
texts.passenger_random_1: I hope the journey will be comfortable and pleasant.
texts.passenger_random_2: Wonder what adventures await me ahead?
texts.passenger_random_3: I've always dreamed of visiting new places by train.
texts.passenger_random_4: I love the sound of wheels on the rails—it's so soothing.
texts.passenger_random_5: Did someone steal your sweet roll?
texts.anecdote_0_0: A patient walks into the doctor's and says
texts.dice_game_opponent_on_early_leave: Do you want <color=#FF7717>to leave</color> already? Okay, we haven't even started yet.
texts.dice_game_opponent_on_leave: Hey! You want <color=#FF7717>to leave</color> in the middle of the game?
texts.shopkeeper_rich_random_0: Oh, the lord arrived in his fancy ride? Take whatever you want, just don't jingle your coins
texts.shopkeeper_rich_random_1: For folks like you, I've got champagne at airplane prices. Can you even afford it?
texts.shopkeeper_rich_random_2: Your Excellency, a pack of smokes? Or do you prefer gold ones with diamonds?
texts.shopkeeper_rich_random_3: Rich guy, pour some from your wallet for me too—I'm scraping by on pennies here
texts.shopkeeper_rich_random_4: Millionaire, don't multiply around here, pay up and head back to your mansion
texts.shopkeeper_poor_random_0: You again, you bum? Stop begging for pennies, go get a job
texts.shopkeeper_poor_random_1: Hobo, can't even scrape together bread money? Get outta here, don't stink up the place
texts.shopkeeper_poor_random_2: Five coins? With that budget, dig in the dumpster, loser
texts.shopkeeper_poor_random_3: Another starving wretch. We don't give freebies—go beg for alms
texts.shopkeeper_poor_random_4: My poor fellow, have you ever looked in a mirror? Pay up or scram
texts.lose_header: I've been kicked off the train. Now my adventure leads me under a bridge, where i'll die stoned.
texts.win_header: I have come a long way and have finally arrived at the final station!
texts.default_description: A balanced dice with equal chances for all faces.
texts.strat_safe_ones_fives_description: Increases the chance of rolling 1 and 5, reducing the risk of a bust.
texts.strat_straight_1_6_hunter_description: Boosts middle values (2–5), making full 1–6 straights more likely.
texts.strat_straight_2_6_hunter_description: Shifts probability toward 2–6 while reducing the chance of rolling 1.
texts.strat_polar_ends_description: Increases the chance of extreme faces (1 and 6) while weakening the middle.
texts.quest_money_goal: Get money for the next train ticket: {0}/{1}
texts.quest_stations_goal: Make it to the last station. Left: {0}
texts.modifier_scramble_combinations_descripti: At the start of each round, combination scores are shuffled. The same rolled combination can be worth a different base score this round
texts.modifier_shake_reroll_description: On roll: has a chance to shake one unsaved die and reroll it, then recalculates your combinations
texts.modifier_multiply_combo_description: On Pass: if you have the specified combination, it gains +1 multiplier
texts.modifier_multiply_kind_description: On Pass: if you have the specified combination with the specified face value, it gains +1 multiplier
texts.modifier_pass_activation_multiplier_desc: Active ability: press to arm it. Your next Pass gets a score multiplier (1 use per in-game day)
texts.modifier_adjust_tick_description: Adjusts the number of ticks (games per day) for the current level by a fixed delta (can increase or decrease)
texts.modifier_extra_dice_cap_description: Increases the maximum dice cap by a fixed amount.
texts.modifier_silencer_item_description: Silences all other modifiers until the end of the round.
texts.modifier_pass_multiplier_item_descriptio: When armed, your next Pass gains a score multiplier.
texts.modifier_reroll_selected_item_descriptio: When armed, the next clicked unsaved die rerolls immediately.
texts.modifier_step_up_item_description: Select several dice, then all dice advance their face by +1.
texts.modifier_copy_face_item_description: Select one die, then another die copies its face.
texts.modifier_target_discount_item_descriptio: Lowers the target score for this match by a fixed amount.
texts.modifier_selected_double_step_item_descr: The next selected die jumps by +2 immediately.
texts.modifier_invert_all_faces_item_descripti: Flips all dice to their opposite face values.
texts.modifier_pair_up_item_description: Select two dice; both become the higher of the two.
texts.modifier_median_blend_item_description: Select three dice; all chosen dice become the middle face among them.
texts.modifier_bank_without_pass_item_descript: Instantly banks your current preview score without ending the turn.
texts.modifier_selected_to_opposite_item_descr: The next selected die flips to its opposite face value.
texts.modifier_pass_score_floor_item_descripti: When armed, your next Pass cannot score below the amount of money currently in your pocket.
texts.modifier_extra_dice_cap_apply: Dice cap increased for this match
texts.modifier_silencer_item_apply: Other modifiers are silenced until round end

texts.modifier_pass_multiplier_item_apply: Your next Pass is boosted with a score multiplier

texts.modifier_target_discount_item_apply: Target score reduced for this match

texts.modifier_selected_double_step_item_apply: The selected die gained 2 face value
texts.modifier_invert_all_faces_item_apply: All dice flipped to opposite faces

texts.modifier_pair_up_item_apply: Both dice became the higher face
